topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found out today that my partner has been working on a novel, and the main character is unmistakably me. I can’t help but wonder what aspects of our life together have made it to the pages. It’s a lot to take in. I’ve been thinking about how to approach this. I want to understand why and what this means. Maybe it’s a way for them to express something they haven’t been able to say directly. I need to gather my thoughts before we talk. I hope we can find a way to turn this into something positive.
